description: This file defines cultural information and date parsing/formatting functions for Danish (Denmark) using the Datejs library. It includes cultural specifics like month and day names, date formats, regex patterns for date parsing, and date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time portion of the date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a given year.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple components of the date object based on a configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a specified day of the week.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specified day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specified month.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Returns the week number of the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Returns the ISO week number of the date.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the date to a specific week number.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the day within its current week.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation of the date.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset of the date.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone of the date.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date is in daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the current date is in daylight saving time.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed milliseconds since the date.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Returns ISO string representation of the date.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the date based on the specified format pattern.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins parsing a date string into a Date object based on configured formats.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a Date object using the default or specified formats.
